//: nodemon's default watch covers .ts and .json under the working directory, which
silently excludes .env — and dotenv only reads the file once, at import time.
So editing a secret in development appears to do nothing: the file changes, the
server keeps running with the old environment, and the app keeps reporting the
feature as unconfigured. Watching .env explicitly is the fix.
No `exec` here on purpose — `npm run dev` passes the entry point, and setting
both makes nodemon append one to the other.
